summary: The root خشي primarily signifies fear, particularly a reverential fear or awe of God. It implies being humbled and submissive due to this fear, often leading to avoidance of what is feared.

headwords.def: خشّاهُ , inf. n. تَخْشِيَةٌ , He frightened him, or made him to fear; (S, K;) [or he made him to dread; or to fear with reverence, &c.; (see 1;)] بِالأَمْرِ [ with the thing, or event ]. (TA.) One says, خَشِّ ذُؤَالَةَ بِالحِبَالَةِ , meaning [ Frighten thou ] the wolf [with the snare]. (S.
